t: Survey Builder- One Question at a Time
html:
“One Question at a Time” is a setting in the Survey Builder that shows one question per screen when someone is filling out your form. It creates a simpler, more focused experience for your audience.

TABLE OF CONTENTS

  • What It Does
  • How to Turn It On
  • Things to Know

What It Does

When enabled:

  • Each survey question appears on a separate slide both for your visitors and in the builder preview.

  • This layout helps keep people engaged by showing only one thing at a time.

This enhancement improves survey design clarity and reduces chances of misconfiguration.

No action is needed from your side unless you want to start using this view for better survey authoring.

How to Turn It On

  1. Open your survey in the Survey Builder.

  2. Click the Styles & Options button in the upper right-hand corner

  3.  Under Survey Type, select the One Question at a Timeoption. Once enabled, you’ll see each field on its own slide while editing just like how it appears to users.

  4. Enable One Question at a Time.

  5. If a conditional logic warning appears, review the message and click Proceed to continue or Cancel to keep the current setting.

Once enabled, each question appears on a separate slide in the builder preview, matching the experience of respondents completing the survey.

Things to Know

  • Conditional Logic: Enabling or disabling One Question at a Time may affect your survey's existing conditional logic. A confirmation dialog warns you about potential impacts before changing the setting. Click Proceed to continue or Cancel to keep the current setting.

  • When One Question at a Time is enabled, object fields added in bulk continue to follow the one-question-per-slide layout. Bulk-added fields are split onto separate slides where appropriate.

  • This setting only changes how the survey is displayed it doesn’t remove or modify your questions.
